==About me==

Hi. Thanks for visiting. I have been reading The Wheel of Time books since '94 or '95 and have gone through several re-reads waiting for "the next book" to come out. This is my first online contribution, but I actually began compiling lists in '99 and had them saved on my computer. I am new to the wiki thing, so please excuse my ignorance of proper formats, etc. I am open to critcism, just be nice.

== What I would like to see...==

This wiki has some great articles, but is still far from complete. There are 700+ wanted articles, besides the ones that have no reference at all, so there is a lot of work to be done. There are several other sites that have some great articles and info, I think it would be nice if everyone could get together and consolidate it all. None of these sites seem to be for-profit.

I would also like to see more documentation in the articles. Some really good ones have been written here with no documentation to speak of. It would be much easier to fine-tune, expand and clarify articles if they were well documented.

== Thanks ==

Thanks to all the contributors who have come before me. You have done a heck of a job.
